2026-10-09 evening, the author's list: flags and bars removed; Natera's army in the south-west fires on El Grillo from 10:00; Villa's soldiers (a copy of the villista statue) fire on La Sierpe as they march; the guns turn to their targets and fire on La Bufa and Cerro de Loreto, then from Loreto on La Bufa, La Sierpe and El Grillo; the federal groups fire back, fall back from El Grillo to the centre and, after the 17:00 explosion, to La Bufa, and leave past the south-east corner when it falls at 19:00. One timeline lane; the control row is at the top, the caption in the bottom-right corner.
